CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MOHAMMAD NAWAZ  ORAL ORDER Petitioners have preferred this petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C seeking quashing of the FIR and complaint in Crime No.47/2024 registered against them at Kalaburagi City CEN Crime Police Station, for offences punishable under Sections 417, 418, 419, 420, 465, 468 read with 149 of IPC.
2.
Respondent No.2 / Manager of Manappuram Finance Ltd., Om Nagar, Sedam Road, Kalaburagi,

has lodged a complaint alleging that the Manappuram Finance Ltd., launched a scheme in the name of 'Manappuram Teachers Loan' for giving loan to Teachers and under the said scheme advertisement was carried out and pamphlets NC: 2024:KHC-K:9558 were distributed.

The petitioners by portraying themselves as Teachers obtained forged letters of several schools and submitted their applications between 11.09.2023 to 22.02.2024 and got sanctioned loan in their respective names.
It is alleged that the petitioners have availed the loan by playing fraud by cheating the Finance Company Ltd., by creating fictitious documents etc.
3. Petitioners as well as respondent No.2/de-facto complainant are present before the Court.
4. An application is filed seeking permission of the Court to permit the petitioners and respondent No.2 to compound the offences.
5. Respondent No.2 has filed an affidavit stating that he is withdrawing the entire allegations made against the petitioners.

It is further stated that the dispute is private in nature and the petitioners have agreed to repay the loan amount and in view of amicable settlement of the NC:
2024:KHC-K:9558 entire dispute between the complaint and petitioners, he has no interest to prosecute the case any further.
6.

The learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 has also filed a memo along with copy of the minutes of meeting held on 26.10.2024 signed by one Justin Shajji for Manappuram Finance Ltd.,
Valapad, Thrissur, Kerala, giving authorization to Branch Managers etc., to represent before any Anisa Begum And Ors vs The State And Anr on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27439643/
5 Court and to conduct the procedure including to compromise/compound any Court cases etc.

8. The dispute is private in nature.

In view of the joint memo filed for amicable settlement and the submission made by the complainant that, he do not wish to prosecute the case against the petitioners, continuation of the proceedings would be a futile exercise.
The interest of justice will be met if the proceedings against the petitioners are quashed.

9. Accordingly the following:
NC: 2024:KHC-K:9558 ORDER i.
The petition is allowed.

ii. The entire proceedings arising out of FIR and complaint in Crime No.47/2024 registered at Kalaburagi City CEN Crime Police Station, for offence punishable under Sections 417, 418, 419, 420,
465, 468 read with 149 of IPC as against the petitioners are quashed.
